defaults.video_script: Liverpool paid more for him than any British club had ever paid for a teenager. A hundred and sixteen million pounds, for a kid who had torn his cruciate ligament at nineteen. Leverkusen had told every club the same thing. He does not want money, he wants a project. Bayern offered more. He said no. And the first thing he asked Liverpool was not about wages. He asked how many minutes he would actually play. Which makes you wonder,
